coverage: tangency-labs/solidcore#1528 follow-up: does a volume query on the operand change what the shell sees? Each case shells as issue1528.json does (SmApiShellBrepFull -2, extended convex edges, merged results, open at x = 42.5) through the measured entry point (sc_offset_offset_executive_p2_eval_measured), at the default fixes: volume_query result = the result's SmApiBrepComputeVolume (accuracy 1e-6) after the call; source_first = also the operand's volume queried before the call (brep_volume on the Rust side). Both report the operand state right after the (optional) query and before the call (operand: trimmed edge-use count, each trim's end control points in GetEdgeuses order, each vertex use's vertex/face gap in GetVertexuses order), so result is the no-query baseline and source_first shows what the query wrote.
